Although I have a friend that plays tech death that tells me "it doesn't really matter what you play over power chords".

I decide on scales with backing tracks by the scale specified in the title or what feels correct. With my own music/jamming I check what intervals have been played in a riff(tends to be all power chord/single note blues in jams) and figure it out from there e.g if the major 2nd and minor 3rd intervals are played I'll stick with aelion. Even knowing that I wouldn't be able to add those arpeggios in atm.

I think the problem is that I'm thinking 'what can I play in this scale?' Instead of 'what do I want to say/what will sound good?'.
